# Dhwani Sagar — Inside the Illustrated Diary

A personal portfolio presented as a hand-illustrated, scroll-driven diary. Visitors arrive at an
illustrated desk scene, zoom into a stack of books, the book opens, and each page of the diary
introduces a different part of Dhwani's story.

## Who it is for
Recruiters, founders and product people who want to understand how Dhwani thinks, works and builds —
and anyone open to collaborating on product ideas.

## What's inside
- Hello: Dhwani Sagar — product builder, product thinker, curious human; computer science graduate with fintech experience, independent builder still learning and experimenting.
- What I Do: turning what-ifs into what's next through problem exploring, product thinking, experience designing, prototyping and building (think, design, build, repeat).
- Obsession: ideas, unexpected possibilities, little details, making useful things more interesting; currently coding a lot and learning new things; open to product roles.
- The Work Chapter: FYERS, Apprentice, Jul 2025 – Dec 2025, Bengaluru, India — onboarding/signup workflows with product, engineering and analytics; event tracking validation across Google Analytics, CleverTap and AppsFlyer; API and workflow validation with Postman and cURL.
- The Scrapbook of Made Things: live projects — Dahlia, StreakUp, Stack Optimizer, Product Thinking Teardowns, SignalDesk — plus the diary site itself.
- Guestbook: visitors can leave a note at the back of the diary.
